subject: FY 2027 Budget Process and Financial Update
overview: The City Council and School Committee held a joint meeting to review the FY 2027 budget process schedule and receive a municipal financial update from the chief financial officer.

items.title: FY 2027 Budget Process and Financial Presentation
items.summary: Council President Zac Bears presented the FY 2027 budget schedule, and Chief Financial Officer Bob Dickinson delivered a financial update outlining revenue estimates, fixed cost increases, and an initial budget gap.
